output.description: A boolean array of same shape as ``x`` containing ``True`` where ``x`` is not ``inf``, ``-inf``, or ``NaN``, and ``False`` otherwise.

constraints: jax.numpy.isinf, jax.numpy.isposinf, jax.numpy.isneginf, jax.numpy.isnan can be used to check for infinity or NaN values in the input.
